newsitem.title: USA: Banco de Venezuela, Consolidado to be sold Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Venezuela, Consolidado to be sold Dec 18.

text.p: Venezuela will privatize state banks Banco de Venezuela and Banco Consolidado on December 18, Finance Minister Luis Ral Matos Azcar said Friday.

"Venezuela maintains the intention of continuing its privatization drive. The next step is the sale of Banco de Venezuela and Consolidado on December 18," Matos told a news conference to mark the debut of national telephone CANTV on the New York Stock Exchange.
Matos added that base prices for the two banks would be announced on December 4.
Banco de Venezuela and Banco Consolidado were taken over by the government in late 1994 during a financial sector crisis which claimed over half the commercial banking sector.
The State Deposits Guarantee Fund (Fogade), which owns the banks' shares, was forced to call off the sale of Banco de Venezuela in August as interested bidders withdrew due to doubts about the sale.
Fogade announced in October that six potential bidders had qualified for the Banco de Venezuela sale and 13 for Consolidado.
Interested bidders for the two banks include Spain's Banco Santander and France's Banque Paribas.
